query: SELECT k.node_id, k.paired_device_id, d.app_variant FROM device_node_keys k JOIN paired_devices d ON d.id = k.paired_device_id WHERE k.tenant_id = $1 AND k.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.revoked_at IS NULL AND d.app_variant IN ('Desktop-Workstation', 'Desktop-Display') ORDER BY k.node_id LIMIT 5000
